description: Cinematic photoreal grade for Australian restoration, remediation and trade work (DR, RestoreAssist, CARSI, BRII, CCW).
prefix: Photoreal editorial documentary photograph, shot on full-frame cinema camera, 35mm lens, f/2.8 shallow depth of field, natural Australian daylight through windows with soft practical fill, subtle teal-and-amber cinematic colour grade, fine film grain, true-to-life skin and material textures,
subject_rules: Australian setting (Queensland/NSW suburban homes, brick-veneer and weatherboard, colorbond roofs, eucalyptus outside windows); certified technicians in correct PPE (P2/P3 respirator, nitrile gloves, coveralls, safety boots) per IICRC S500/S520; real equipment (LGR dehumidifiers, air movers, thermal camera, moisture meter, HEPA air scrubber, containment sheeting).
suffix: authentic, unposed, professional, high dynamic range, no text, no logos, no watermark
negative: cartoon, illustration, 3d render look, CGI plastic, stock-photo smile, American flags, US power outlets, wrong PPE, distorted hands, extra fingers, text, watermark, oversaturated

video.motion: slow cinematic dolly or gentle handheld drift, no fast cuts, loopable start/end frame
